```{r include=FALSE}
# ── 1. Install / load packages ───────────────────────────────────────────────
if (!require("dplyr"))           install.packages("dplyr")
if (!require("stringr"))         install.packages("stringr")
if (!require("leaflet"))         install.packages("leaflet")
if (!require("leaflet.extras"))  install.packages("leaflet.extras")
if (!require("leafem"))          install.packages("leafem")
if (!require("htmltools"))       install.packages("htmltools")
if (!require("htmlwidgets"))     install.packages("htmlwidgets")
if (!require("RColorBrewer"))    install.packages("RColorBrewer")

library(dplyr)
library(stringr)
library(leaflet)
library(leaflet.extras)
library(leafem)
library(htmltools)
library(htmlwidgets)
library(RColorBrewer)
```

```{r echo=FALSE}
# ── 1. Load Packages ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
library(leaflet)
library(leaflet.extras)
library(dplyr)
library(htmltools)

# ── 2. Load and Prep Data ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
# Reading the uploaded CSV
palm_oil <- read.csv("palm_oil.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# Clean and handle missing values
palm_oil <- palm_oil %>%
  mutate(
    lat = as.numeric(latitude),
    lng = as.numeric(longitude),
    capacity = as.numeric(capacity_tonnes_ffb_hour),
    # Pre-formatting for display labels
    group_val = ifelse(is.na(group) | group == "", "Unknown", group),
    company_val = ifelse(is.na(company) | company == "", "Unknown", company),
    mill_val = ifelse(is.na(mill_name) | mill_name == "", "Unnamed Mill", mill_name),
    status_val = ifelse(is.na(status) | status == "", "Unknown", status),
    year_val = ifelse(is.na(earliest_year_of_existence), "N/A", earliest_year_of_existence),
    source_val = ifelse(is.na(earliest_year_of_existence_source) | earliest_year_of_existence_source == "", "N/A", earliest_year_of_existence_source)
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(lat) & !is.na(lng))

# ── 3. Define Color Palette for Capacity ────────────────────────────────────
# Mapping capacity from 0 to 120; points with NA capacity are colored grey (#808080)
pal <- colorNumeric(
  palette = "YlOrRd",
  domain = c(0, 120),
  na.color = "#808080"
)

# ── 4. Build Popup Content ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
palm_oil$popup_content <- paste0(
  "<div style='font-family: sans-serif; min-width: 250px;'>",
  "<h4 style='margin: 0; color: #1b5e20;'>", palm_oil$mill_val, "</h4>",
  "<hr style='margin: 5px 0;'>",
  "<b>Group:</b> ", palm_oil$group_val, "<br/>",
  "<b>Company:</b> ", palm_oil$company_val, "<br/>",
  "<b>Capacity (tonnes/hr):</b> ", ifelse(is.na(palm_oil$capacity), "Unknown", palm_oil$capacity), "<br/>",
  "<b>Status:</b> ", palm_oil$status_val, "<br/>",
  "<b>Est. Year:</b> ", palm_oil$year_val, "<br/>",
  "<div style='margin-top: 8px; font-size: 11px; color: #555; border-top: 1px solid #eee; padding-top: 5px;'>",
  "<b>Source:</b> ", palm_oil$source_val, "</div>",
  "</div>"
)

# ── 5. Build Map ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
m <- leaflet(palm_oil, width = "100%", height = "100vh", options = leafletOptions(zoomControl = TRUE)) %>%
  # Base Map Layers
  addProviderTiles(providers$CartoDB.Positron, group = "Street Map") %>%
  addProviderTiles(providers$Esri.WorldImagery, group = "Satellite") %>%
  setView(lng = 118, lat = -2, zoom = 5) %>%
  
  # Add Mill Markers
  addCircleMarkers(
    lng = ~lng, lat = ~lat,
    radius = 2,
    fillColor = ~pal(capacity),
    color = "white",
    weight = 1,
    fillOpacity = 0.8,
    popup = ~popup_content,
    label = ~mill_val,
    group = "Mills"
  ) %>%
  
  # ── 6. UI Controls & Legends ──────────────────────────────────────────────
   # Legend 1: Unknown (Outside/Separate box)
  addLegend(
    "bottomright",
    colors = "#808080",
    labels = "Unknown Capacity (tonnes FFB/hr)",
    title = NULL,
    opacity = 1
  ) %>% 
  
  # Legend 2: Main Capacity Scale (0 - 120)
  addLegend(
    "bottomright",
    pal = pal,
    values = c(0, 120),
    title = "Capacity (tonnes FFB/hr)",
    opacity = 1
  ) %>%
  
  # Mini Map (Bottom Left)
  addMiniMap(
    position = "bottomleft",
    tiles = providers$CartoDB.Positron,
    toggleDisplay = TRUE,
    minimized = FALSE
  ) %>%
  
  # Layer Control
  addLayersControl(
    baseGroups = c("Street Map", "Satellite"),
    overlayGroups = "Mills",
    options = layersControlOptions(collapsed = FALSE)
  ) %>%
  
  # Additional Utilities
  addFullscreenControl() %>%
  addSearchFeatures(targetGroups = "Mills", options = searchFeaturesOptions(zoom = 12)) %>%
  leafem::addMouseCoordinates()

# Render Map
m


# To save as a clean, full-screen standalone file
saveWidget(m, "index.html", selfcontained = TRUE)
```
